steps.instruction: Select an object, then open the Object menu.
steps.spoken: Click an object to select it. Then open the Object menu.
steps.why: Blender acts on whatever is selected, so selecting comes first.
steps.hint_if_stuck: The Object menu is in the bar above the 3D view, after Add.

steps.instruction: Click Duplicate Objects, move the mouse, then click to place the copy.
steps.spoken: Click Duplicate Objects. Move the mouse and click to drop the copy.
steps.why: A duplicate is a photocopy you can then change on its own.
steps.hint_if_stuck: After you click Duplicate Objects the copy sticks to the mouse. Click once to put it down.

steps.spoken: Open the Object menu again. We will delete the copy.
steps.why: Deleting is safe in Blender. You can always undo with Control Z.
steps.hint_if_stuck: The Object menu is in the bar above the 3D view.

steps.spoken: Click Delete. The selected copy disappears.
steps.why: Only the selected object is removed, so check the selection first.
steps.hint_if_stuck: Delete is near the bottom of the Object menu.
